summary: Roosevelt NF trailer lookout in Larimer County, CO, set up during timber harvesting; last used in 1966, probably taken down in 1967 or 1968.

facts.design: temporary house trailer with an 8'x8' cupola and a firefinder
facts.status_note: Trailer removed, probably 1967 or 1968 per the register; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as removed. No source describes the site now.

staffing.status: manned in summer 1963 by a Forest Service summer employee

access.note: No source describes access to the site

events.note: 1963 Fort Collins newspaper item: new station on a trailer house in the Sheep Creek logging unit, 45 miles west of Fort Collins, manned by a summer Forest Service employee
Register: the last year the lookout was used was 1966
Register: probably taken down in 1967 or 1968; the earlier year is used here
Registered September 5, 2011 as FFLOS US 1138, CO 17; nominated by Nate White and Kent Argow

sources.title: Crown Point - Forest Lookouts (newspaper items transcribed)

notes_for_editor: The register gives no build date, so the record has no built event; the 1963 newspaper item is the earliest dated mention. The 1967 removal year is the earlier of the register's two probable years. The 1963 item names a summer employee; the name is left out of the story and the research record. Both sources are short, and no photo or later description of the site was found.
